metadata.title: Dean's Fitness App - VeilCode Case Study
metadata.description:
Dean’s Fitness is a mobile fitness and nutrition application built to help users access structured workout programs, video based classes, meal guidance, and personalized fitness support from one platform. The app supports clients, trainers, and nutritionists, creating a scalable digital fitness ecosystem where users can train, track progress, receive guidance, and manage their wellness journey directly from their phones.

The product was designed as a subscription based fitness platform with room for premium add ons such as custom nutrition plans, expert coaching, and paid fitness programs.
